title: Enterprise Networking & Proxies API
summary: Configure HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5, and PAC proxies, remote DNS leak protection, and dynamic proxy switching.

sections.title: Supported Proxy Modes
sections.content:
Kromium models proxy configurations via the type-safe sealed class KromiumProxy.

| Mode | Class | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **System Default** | `KromiumProxy.System` | Adopts host OS proxy settings. |
| **Direct** | `KromiumProxy.Direct` | Bypasses all proxies. |
| **Auto-Detect** | `KromiumProxy.AutoDetect` | Uses WPAD via DHCP and DNS queries. |
| **PAC Script** | `KromiumProxy.Pac(pacUrl)` | Downloads and evaluates PAC script. |
| **HTTP / HTTPS** | `KromiumProxy.Http(...)` | Standard HTTP or TLS-encrypted forward proxy. |
| **SOCKS5 / SOCKS4** | `KromiumProxy.Socks5(...)` | SOCKS proxy with optional remote DNS leak protection. |
| **Multi-Protocol** | `KromiumProxy.MultiProtocol(...)` | Routes different protocols through separate endpoints. |

sections.title: Configuring Proxies
sections.content: Configure the proxy when building KromiumConfig before engine startup.

codeSnippet.code:
val config = KromiumConfig.builder()
    .browserConfig { b ->
        b.proxy(
            KromiumProxy.Http(
                host = "proxy.corp.internal",
                port = 8080,
                username = "corporate_user",
                password = "secure_password",
                isSecure = true,
                bypassList = listOf("<local>", "127.0.0.1", "*.internal.net")
            )
        )
    }
    .build()

sections.title: SOCKS5 with Remote DNS Leak Protection
sections.content: Setting remoteDns = true ensures DNS queries are resolved exclusively through the proxy rather than leaking to local ISP.

codeSnippet.code:
val socks5 = KromiumProxy.Socks5(
    host = "10.0.0.1",
    port = 1080,
    remoteDns = true
)

sections.title: Dynamic Runtime Proxy Switching
sections.content: Switch proxies dynamically on active client sessions without restarting the engine.
